topic: Adjusting dwell time calculation for specific client
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the real-time accuracy of dwell time data and a specific request to adjust the calculation for one client, Citrus. Initially, it was noted that live dwell time data is not guaranteed accurate across all clients.

[p1] requested that a newly calculated dwell time metric be deployed to production (prod) but initially only active for Citrus. This new method would potentially be used later for other companies like Malaysia and Primidia.

[me] confirmed that the mechanism was ready on staging and could be released with the next major release, though it could theoretically be done sooner. However, due to the complexity of hotfixes, delaying deployment until the planned release was suggested.

Later, [p1] insisted that the change must go live before the release because the client demanded it, despite previous information suggesting it would apply broadly on staging.
decisions: The new dwell time calculation for Citrus will be deployed to production (prod) prior to the next scheduled release date.
action_items: [me] needs to prioritize and implement the change into a Jira task (DOOH-2017).
